name: 3 Cup 500ML Double-Layer Stainless Steel Vacuum Flask Set | Hot & Cold | Travel Thermos
description:
Keep your drinks hot or cold for up to 10 hours with the 3 Cup 500ML Stainless Steel Vacuum Flask Set. Its double-layer insulation maintains temperature while preventing burns or condensation. Designed with a leak-proof stopper, easy-carry handle, and non-slip base, it’s perfect for home, office, gym, travel, or outdoor adventures. The included cups make it convenient to share drinks anytime.
Key Features:
 Double-wall stainless steel vacuum insulation
 Keeps beverages hot or cold up to 10 hours
 Leak-proof stopper with one-button pour design
 Non-slip rubber base for stability
 Comes with cups for easy sharing
 Durable, food-grade & stylish design
How to Use:
 Preheat or precool flask with hot/cold water for best results
 Fill with desired beverage and close stopper tightly
 Press one-button stopper to pour into cups
 Hand wash recommended for long-lasting use
Material:
Food-Grade Stainless Steel, PP Material, Rubber Base
Safety Information:
 Do not place in microwave or freezer
 Keep away from children when filled with hot liquids
 Ensure lid is securely closed to avoid spills
 Avoid using for carbonated or perishable drinks
Package Includes:
 1 × 500ML Stainless Steel Vacuum Flask
 2 × Cups
